used_sources.name: Python Documentation
used_sources.use: Short evidence passages and source-backed synthetic claims; URLs and sections retained.

candidates.name: FEVER
candidates.license: Wikipedia terms / CC BY-SA 3.0 fallback per official notice
candidates.decision: Excluded: Wikipedia domain; evidence references need dereferencing; licensing/share-alike obligations.

candidates.name: SciFact
candidates.license: Annotations CC BY 4.0; abstract corpus ODC-By 1.0
candidates.decision: Excluded: biomedical domain and labeled set lacks a robust insufficient-evidence class.

candidates.name: StaQC
candidates.license: Dataset card CC BY 4.0; original Stack Overflow posts retain revision-specific CC BY-SA terms
candidates.decision: Excluded: code/question pairs, not claim-evidence truth labels.

candidates.name: CoNaLa
candidates.license: No explicit dataset license identified on project page; Stack Overflow sourced
candidates.decision: Excluded: intent/code pairs, no claim-evidence labels; license unclear.

candidates.name: CodeSearchNet
candidates.license: Repository MIT; underlying samples have per-record repository licenses

selection_policy: Require programming domain, explicit claim and evidence, mappable three-way labels, usable redistribution license, and traceable record-level provenance. No source met all requirements.
